Apache-2.0; upstream source files retain their original copyright notices.

Native mpv and FFmpeg shared libraries are copied unchanged from this public
source checkout. Their upstream projects and licenses:
https://github.com/FongMi/mpv
https://github.com/FongMi/FFmpeg
https://github.com/FongMi/mpv-android
https://github.com/FongMi/media/tree/3c2cbe8ac742c2fe15eff52f03eeb3b1b648848d/libraries/mpvplayer
https://github.com/FongMi/media/tree/3c2cbe8ac742c2fe15eff52f03eeb3b1b648848d/libraries/decoder_ffmpeg

This distribution does not reconstruct dependencies from an official APK.
Libass and the Exo FFmpeg JNI bridge are not included in this build.
